question: The perimeter of an isosceles right-angled triangle having an area of 200 cm² is:
solution:
Given:

Area of triangle = 200 cm²

Concept used:

Using the concept of Pythagoras's theorem

Base² + Height² = Hypotenuse²

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3954312431f0cc2de9895f76b8ad0eb67051dff0d251948214fe14632ff1df0.png] 

Let the equal sides of the isosceles triangle be x cm

AB = BC = x

Area of triangle = 1/2 × BC × AB

⇒ 200 = 1/2 × x × x

⇒ x² = 400

⇒ x = 20 cm

AB = BC = 20 cm

By using Pythagoras's theorem

AB² + BC² = AC²

⇒ 20² + 20² = AC²

⇒ AC = 20√2 cm

⇒ AC = 20 * 1.41

⇒ AC = 28.2

The perimeter of triangle = 20 + 20 + 28.2

⇒ 68.3

**The perimeter of the triangle is 68.3 cm.**
